name: Transit World
detailed_description:
Transit World is your chance to build your own transport company in a dynamic, fictional world. From a small taxi business to a large logistics group - you decide how your company grows. Develop clever strategies, hire staff, invest in modern vehicles and ensure a functioning transport network.

Whether you plan routes, coordinate delivery orders or get behind the wheel yourself - Transit World combines business simulation with direct vehicle control in an exciting and varied world.

Game world

The world of Transit World is completely fictional - but inspired by the real Central Europe. You can expect varied landscapes, dense cities, rural regions, industrial areas, motorways and much more. You build your company in a region that develops, changes and reacts to your decisions.

Vehicles

  • MAN Lion's City (licensed)
  • MAN Lion's Coach (licensed)
  • MAN TGX (licensed)
  • MAN TGE (licensed)
  • 2 further vans
  • 2 more lorries
  • 1 further city bus
  • 1 further coach
  • 3 trailers
  • 3 high-capacity taxis
  • 2 taxi limousines
  • 4 standard taxis
  • 1 forklift truck
... and more

Gameplay features

list]
  • Start as a small business owner and develop into a logistics company
  • Manage finances, personnel, routes and vehicles
  • Drive yourself or leave it to your staff
  • Simulate bus, taxi and freight transport
  • Intelligent order and customer logic
... and more

Licences & partners

  • MAN Truck & Bus Switzerland
  • PostBus AG
  • AutoBus AG
  • Enagdin Bus
  • Atron Switzerland
  • FELA Management
  • Zelisko
... and others

The shortage of skilled labour - a key issue in Transit World

In many European countries, transport companies are faced with an ever-growing problem: the shortage of drivers. There is a lack of qualified drivers for buses, lorries and other transport vehicles, which not only affects the efficiency and profitability of companies, but also poses challenges for the entire transport sector.
Transit World aims to address this issue and give players the opportunity to deal with the real-life challenges of the industry in a simulation. In the world of Transit World, you can experience for yourself how the driver shortage affects your company. You will not only be confronted with the economic challenges of staff planning, but also with the need to find innovative solutions to keep your fleet running.

Transit World is a project from the heart - developed with a passion for vehicles, simulation and strategy. Get on board and create your own transport world!

short_description: In the transport simulation Transit World, you set up your own transport company. Start with a simple taxi business and work your way up to a bus company to eventually become an established logistics company.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 (2 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
